sections.title: ١– اﳌﺒﺎدئ

summary.text: Sets out the principles agreed by WHO Member States, recalling earlier resolutions and noting the threat of a pandemic, especially for developing countries. It commits states to share H5N1 and other potential pandemic influenza viruses and their benefits on an equal footing, and recognises the sovereign right over biological resources, the importance of technology transfer and the need to fund access to vaccines in developing countries.
